basis: Retained committed A3 code and existing staging/launch receipts only; no host probe or received scientific-result access.

expected_a6_wall_time.ack_not_before: Recorded exit_utc +1300s, independently of expected duration.
expected_a6_wall_time.additional_work: 3600 full decisions plus exactness, backend setup, per-state preparation, guard handshakes, cleanup, sealing and post-exit transport.
expected_a6_wall_time.qualification: 1296s is the sum of nominal deadline budgets, not observed runtime, an enforced total bound, or a guaranteed minimum. This A6 executes the complete three-repeat fleet-reference path; it is not limited to its 300s warmup.
expected_a6_wall_time.reason: No retained mean duration for the unbudgeted full-decision work or preprocessing; a fixed total/finish ETA would be unsupported.

scheduling.defer_missed_window: First clean window after that host next actual apt-daily run, with both actual runs exited and fresh full-window apt/motd clearance. No margin relaxation.
scheduling.refusal_or_failure: STOP/report; no retry without new coordinator ruling.
